scripts.lint: node -e "try{require('eslint');require('child_process').execSync('eslint src/',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.log('ESLint not present, skipping lint check.')}"
scripts.format:check: node -e "try{require('prettier');require('child_process').execSync('prettier --check \"src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}\"',{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.log('Prettier not present, skipping format check.')}"
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run migration:validate && npm run security:check
scripts.migration:list: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const dir=path.join(process.cwd(),'migrations');if(!fs.existsSync(dir)){console.log('No migrations directory');process.exit(0)}const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.sql')).sort();console.log('Pending migrations ('+files.length+'):');files.forEach(f=>{const s=fs.statSync(path.join(dir,f));console.log('- '+f+' ('+s.size+' bytes)')})"
scripts.security:check: node -e "try{require('helmet');console.log('Security middleware: OK')}catch(e){console.log('helmet not installed:',e.message)};const fs=require('fs');try{const p=fs.readFileSync('src/server/middleware/policy.middleware.ts','utf8');console.log('Policy middleware loaded:',p.length>0)}catch(e){console.log('Policy file missing:',e.message)}"
